extracted.name: Brown Butter Chocolate Chip Cookies
extracted.description: Great recipe for Brown Butter Chocolate Chip Cookies.
instruction_lines: Start by heating butter in a pot over medium heat. Stir continuously as the butter starts to melt. After a few minutes butter will start to bubble and foam up. Once the foam subsides you’ll be left w a brown nutty aroma
Pour brown butter into a glass container. Cover and freeze for 10 minutes
Once brown butter mixture has settled take the butter and mix it into a bowl with the Brown sugar and White sugar. Mix until smooth
Crack 1 egg into a bowl and whisk. Take the whisked eggs and measure out 2 tbsp to add into the sugar mixture. Then add in your splash of vanilla
Once mixture is smooth add in your flour, cornstarch, baking soda, salt
Lastly fold in your chocolate chips. Shape dough into balls and bake for 8-10m. Top w flakey sea salt and enjoy!
